note: The hourly task walks CURRICULUM.courses in `order`. The cursor points at course -> topic -> structure. Each run authors CURRICULUM.meta.itemsPerRun structures (2), then advances; at the end of a topic advance topicIndex; at the end of a course move to the next course in `order`; past the last course set done=true. coveredStructures[courseKey] lists structures already authored (skip duplicates). Advance the cursor ONLY past structures whose scene passed tools/validate-scenes.mjs — a blocked scene stays on the worklist.
